data.name: Pravin Chaudhari
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Pravin Chaudhari has made a big mark in cricket. With 49 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 100*, with an average of 24.43 and a quick strike rate of 158.79. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 79 sixes and 97 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 82.5 overs, taking 31 wickets at an economy rate of 9.30. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
